# TripExpert

> > TripExpert aggregates expert reviews from Michelin Guide, Fodor's, Lonely Planet, and other trusted travel sources to help travelers discover highly-rated restaurants, attractions, and hotels worldwide.

TripExpert synthesizes professional travel critic reviews and expert recommendations across destinations globally, combining scores from major travel publications to provide curated travel guidance. The platform also offers an API for developers to access venue data and expert review content.

## Key Topics

- Expert Reviews
- Michelin Guide
- Fodor's
- Lonely Planet
- Restaurant Reviews
- Attraction Reviews
- Travel Recommendations
- Hidden Gems
- Art Deco Architecture
- Cultural Attractions
- Wine Bars
- Grill Restaurants
- Street Murals
- Old Town Dining
- Traveler Reviews
